scope: M8-OUTPUTS initial managed static-model preview checkpoint; complete native resize/minimize/close workflow remains open

abi.migration: same-deployment native and managed artifacts update together; ABI 1 is rejected by the new factory; archived ABI 1 evidence stays valid for its recorded binaries
abi.extension: native Preview(context, uintptr HWND, uint operation); managed PreviewHandle(context) and PreviewClosed(context); operation 0 opens, 1 requests close

toolbar_command.9: open independent woodbox_mil preview or request its close

model.instance: typed static_model_clone_request through the registered resource cook
model.sharing: immutable model data, mesh, original materials and device resources
model.isolation: independent instance overrides, scene, view, HWND, surface/swapchain, render targets, presentation state and history

window.automated: hidden, nonactivating, input-transparent, explicitly opted into fenced readback

close: WM_CLOSE requests native retirement and retains HWND; renderer drains GPU work and acknowledges even an output closed before first adoption; native scene/view/output references drain before managed PreviewClosed disposes the HWND; host shutdown retains both windows through Vulkan teardown

smoke.capture_phase: publish on the actual sixteenth main content frame, allowing asynchronous preview cooks between frames; toolbar opens preview after the first ready main frame
smoke.pending_cooks: main continues presenting its last stable content phase with particles paused, then resumes simulation; require a redraw receipt on the editor owner

remaining_acceptance: combined native main/preview resize and minimize controls
preview close/reopen while main continues with image oracles
close host with pending preview resource work
